sloka: मम चाप गुण उन्मुक्तैः बाण जालैः निरंतरम् ।मर्दितम् मम नाराचैः ध्वस्त भ्रांत मृग द्विजम् ॥३-६४-६४॥
transliteration: mama cāpa guṇa unmuktaiḥ bāṇa jālaiḥ niraṁtaram ।marditam mama nārācaiḥ dhvasta bhrāṁta mṛga dvijam ॥3-64-64॥

translations.english: Lakshmana no beings will be able to move in the sky, blocked by arrows released from my bowstring there will be no space left there.
